_comments.instructions: REST version (no JCo needed). Replace placeholders:
_comments.ABAP_MCP_EXE: Path to abap-mcp.exe (from VS Code extension or built from source)
_comments.SAP_USERNAME: SAP dialog user with ADT authorization
_comments.TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED: Set to '0' for self-signed certs (test only)
_comments.PROXY: Remove or leave empty if no proxy needed
